dialogue.content: 入りました
dialogue.English: I'm here.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。30分になったらスタートしますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for joining. We'll start at the half hour.

dialogue.content: はい、承知しました
dialogue.English: Yes, understood.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。今日は相談に来てくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 最初に性別と年代を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your gender and age range?

dialogue.content: ２０代　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 20s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか?
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: ずっと、頑固な便秘に苦しんでます
dialogue.English: I've been suffering from stubborn constipation for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: It really is.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からですか?
dialogue.English: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: もう何年も、覚えてないくらい前からです
dialogue.English: It's been for so many years that I can't even remember when it started.

dialogue.content: 長年、すっきりしない状態が続いていると、やりきれないですよね。
dialogue.English: It must feel unbearable for that discomfort to continue for so many years.

dialogue.content: もう、ホント毎日苦しんでます
dialogue.English: I'm really, truly suffering every day.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います。
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、受診されたことはありますか?
dialogue.English: By the way, have you ever seen a doctor about this?

dialogue.content: はい、アドバイスも受けてはいるんですが、どうも自分には合わないと思うんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I have, and I've received advice, but I don't think it really works for me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: アドバイスを受けているのに・・・となると、なんだか希望が見えないですよね。
dialogue.English: When you're receiving advice and it's not helping... it must feel hopeless.

dialogue.content: まさに、そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's exactly it.

dialogue.content: おつらいですね。
dialogue.English: That must be painful.

dialogue.content: しんどいです
dialogue.English: It's exhausting.

dialogue.content: 便秘が原因で生活に支障は出ていないですか?
dialogue.English: Is the constipation interfering with your daily life?

dialogue.content: たくさんあります
dialogue.English: Yes, in many ways.

dialogue.content: 例えば、何が一番大変ですか?
dialogue.English: For example, what is the most challenging part?

dialogue.content: こんなんじゃ、就職もままならないし、
dialogue.English: In this state, I can't even hold down a proper job...

dialogue.content: はい（聴いています）
dialogue.English: Yes (I'm listening).

dialogue.content: 現在は、学生さんですか?
dialogue.English: Are you currently a student?

dialogue.content: いえ、そのこともあってなかなか仕事も長続きしないんです
dialogue.English: No, and that's one of the reasons I can't seem to keep a job for long.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。ご苦労されてきましたね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've been through a lot.

dialogue.content: 私なんか、どこに行ってもつとまらない、って家族に言われるし、
dialogue.English: My family tells me that I can't stick with anything, no matter where I go...

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいからいい加減に就職しろ、って言われます
dialogue.English: They tell me to just get a job already because it's embarrassing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。悲しいですね。自分のせいではないのに・・・
dialogue.English: I see. That's so sad, especially since it's not your fault...

dialogue.content: いいえ、私が悪いんですよ
dialogue.English: No, it is my fault.

dialogue.content: みんなに言われるのも、仕方ないって思ってます
dialogue.English: I feel like I deserve what everyone says to me.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思われているんですね。なかなか便秘はコントロールしにくいものだと思いますが・・・。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. I would think constipation is something quite difficult to control, though...

dialogue.content: 医師の指示通りに
dialogue.English: Following the doctor's instructions...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もやしやキノコを毎日山程食べて、いいと信じ込むとハマって.…
dialogue.English: I eat mountains of bean sprouts and mushrooms every day, and once I convince myself something is good for me, I get fixated on it...

dialogue.content: はまっておられるんですね。
dialogue.English: So you get fixated on it.

dialogue.content: そのこともいい加減にしろと言われ、ダメな私なんです
dialogue.English: I'm told to stop that, too, and it just makes me feel useless.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。何とか治したくて必死なのに…辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're trying so desperately to get better... that must be so painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、ご家族はどのような構成ですか?
dialogue.English: By the way, who is in your family?

dialogue.content: 両親と、兄、おばあちゃん、妹は今、お産で長く居座ってます
dialogue.English: My parents, my older brother, my grandmother, and my younger sister, who is staying for a long time because she just had a baby.

dialogue.content: では、あなたを入れて、6人ですね。
dialogue.English: So, including you, that's six people.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 皆さん、体調のことはご存じなんですか?
dialogue.English: Does everyone know about your condition?

dialogue.content: はい、みんなに呆れられてます
dialogue.English: Yes, everyone is fed up with me.

dialogue.content: 呆れられるとは?・・・はまっているから?
dialogue.English: Fed up? ...Because you get fixated on things?

dialogue.content: いつまで経っても、一人前に仕事にもつけないし…
dialogue.English: Because no matter how much time passes, I can't get a proper job like an adult...

dialogue.content: お仕事のことが、ずいぶん気になっておられるんですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like your work situation is weighing heavily on you.

dialogue.content: 焦ってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: That must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 焦ってるけど、自分は融通がきかないのて、何でもできるわけではないんです
dialogue.English: I am anxious, but I'm not very flexible, so it's not like I can do just any job.

dialogue.content: だから、ひどいわがまま者なんです
dialogue.English: That's why I'm such a terribly selfish person.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか?例えばどのような事でわがままだと思われますか?
dialogue.English: Is that so? For example, what makes you think you are selfish?

dialogue.content: 私は調理するのとか好きなんですけど、まず、味見が出来ないんです
dialogue.English: I like cooking, but to begin with, I can't taste-test food.

dialogue.content: だから、就職しても続かないんです
dialogue.English: That's why even when I get a job, I can't keep it.

dialogue.content: 好きなことがあるのに、続けられないのは、本当に悔しいですね。
dialogue.English: It must be truly frustrating not to be able to continue doing something you like.

dialogue.content: 味見ができないのは?どうしてですか?
dialogue.English: Why can't you taste-test?

dialogue.content: 太るのが怖い…
dialogue.English: I'm scared of gaining weight...

dialogue.content: 味覚、というのではなく、太るということなんですね。
dialogue.English: So it's not about the sense of taste, but about gaining weight.

dialogue.content: それは、便秘と関係していますか?
dialogue.English: Is that related to the constipation?

dialogue.content: はい、太ってしまうと思うと、たとえ先輩に指導されても、きけないんです
dialogue.English: Yes, when I think I'll gain weight, I can't listen, even when a senior colleague is instructing me.

dialogue.content: だから繊維質ならきっと大丈夫って、信じてるんです
dialogue.English: That's why I believe that as long as it's high-fiber, it'll surely be okay.

dialogue.content: そんなんですね。そんなことがあったんですね。だから、繊維質なんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's what happened. That's why you focus on fiber.

dialogue.content: そればっかり毎日買うのは恥ずかしいから、兄に頼んでます
dialogue.English: It's embarrassing to buy only that every day, so I ask my brother to do it for me.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: でも、もういい加減にしろって…
dialogue.English: But he says, “Enough already...”

dialogue.content: 必死な思いが伝わらなくて、もどかしいですね。
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating that they don't understand how desperate you feel.

dialogue.content: ところで・・・
dialogue.English: By the way...

dialogue.content: 悪いのは私ですから仕方ありませんよね
dialogue.English: It's my fault, so it can't be helped, right?

dialogue.content: 繊維質のものを食べ続けて、効果のほどは如何ですか?
dialogue.English: And how effective has it been to continue eating high-fiber foods?

dialogue.content: 全然ダメだから、方法は今まで散々試したけど私には私だけの方法しかない、って思うんです
dialogue.English: It's not working at all. I've tried all sorts of methods, but I feel like there has to be a unique method that works only for me.

dialogue.content: がっかりしましたね。
dialogue.English: That must be disappointing.

dialogue.content: 他にどのような方法を試されたんですか?
dialogue.English: What other methods have you tried?

dialogue.content: 人もいろいろアドバイスしてくれるけど、
dialogue.English: People give me all sorts of advice, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 水たくさん飲んだり、
dialogue.English: Like drinking lots of water,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 動くのは好きなので畑をしたりです
dialogue.English: And since I like being active, I work in a vegetable garden.

dialogue.content: すごいですね。
dialogue.English: That's impressive.

dialogue.content: 畑までされているんですね。
dialogue.English: You even have a garden.

dialogue.content: それくらいしとかないと、親もうるさいんで、
dialogue.English: I have to do at least that much, or my parents will nag me.

dialogue.content: いろいろ言われて出て行きたい
dialogue.English: They say so many things to me, I just want to move out.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that.

dialogue.content: だけど長続きしない、の繰り返し
dialogue.English: But it's just a cycle of not being able to make things last.

dialogue.content: あなた自身、辛くて苦しい体調を何とかしたくて、あれこれ試しているのに・・・
dialogue.English: You yourself are trying all these different things because you want to do something about your painful and difficult condition...

dialogue.content: そんな気持ちになるのは自然なことだと感じますよ。
dialogue.English: I feel it's perfectly natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: 特におばあちゃんには酷く言われる
dialogue.English: My grandmother is especially harsh with me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。あなたは、どのように感じておられますか?
dialogue.English: I see. How does that make you feel?

dialogue.content: いつも小さい頃から、普通の子のように勤められないなんて言われ続けてきたから、やっぱり自分が悪いんだと思います
dialogue.English: Ever since I was little, I've been told that I can't work like a normal person, so I've come to believe that I'm the one at fault.

dialogue.content: 小さい頃から、ずいぶん言われ続けて苦しんでこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: You've been suffering from hearing that since you were a child.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃん嫌い
dialogue.English: I hate my grandmother.

dialogue.content: 妹も赤ちゃんも早く帰ればいいのに
dialogue.English: I wish my sister and her baby would go home soon.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんはどんな人ですか?
dialogue.English: What kind of person is your grandmother?

dialogue.content: 古い頭、カチコチお母さんもなんにも言えないくらい、強いんです
dialogue.English: She's old-fashioned and rigid. She's so domineering that even my mother can't say anything to her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 堅苦しくて、お母さんも苦労されてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like she's very strict, and your mother has had a hard time as well.

dialogue.content: お母さんも
dialogue.English: My mother too...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 教員だから、私が仕事してないのは、いい顔しないし出て行きたい
dialogue.English: She's a teacher, so she doesn't approve of me not working, and I want to move out.

dialogue.content: そんな風な顔でいられると、出ていきたくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: When she looks at you that way, it's natural to want to leave.

dialogue.content: 何回か出たりはしたんだけど、
dialogue.English: I have moved out a few times, but...

dialogue.content: 実行されたんですね。
dialogue.English: So you've actually done it.

dialogue.content: ダメな私なんか…
dialogue.English: A failure like me...

dialogue.content: どうせうまくいかないんですよね
dialogue.English: ...it never works out anyway.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思われるのは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to think of yourself that way.

dialogue.content: あなたの体も心配だし・・・
dialogue.English: I'm also worried about your physical health...

dialogue.content: あなたの望まれる方向に進まれるお手伝いがしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I would like to help you move in the direction you want to go.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていければ、と思います。
dialogue.English: I hope we can think this through together.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: まず、体調ですが
dialogue.English: First, regarding your physical condition...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 便秘は、様々なことに影響しますが、睡眠はとれていますか?
dialogue.English: Constipation can affect many things, but are you able to get enough sleep?

dialogue.content: よく眠れません
dialogue.English: I can't sleep well.

dialogue.content: 辛いですね・・・
dialogue.English: That must be difficult...

dialogue.content: 睡眠不足になると、悲観的な方向に思考も行きますし…
dialogue.English: When we're sleep-deprived, our thoughts tend to go in a more pessimistic direction...

dialogue.content: 少し、リラックスして、まずは質の良い睡眠をとるようにされては如何でしょう?
dialogue.English: How about we try to relax a little and focus on getting good quality sleep first?

dialogue.content: 睡眠？
dialogue.English: Sleep?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたら？
dialogue.English: How can I do that?

dialogue.content: 寝る前ですが、どのように過ごされていますか?
dialogue.English: How do you usually spend your time before bed?

dialogue.content: 今なんか寒いので、特に、少しぬるめのお風呂に長い時間ゆったりとつかる・・・
dialogue.English: Since it's cold now, you could especially try taking a long, relaxing bath in lukewarm water...

dialogue.content: 寝る少し前から、照明を暗くして、落ち着く雰囲気をつくる
dialogue.English: A little while before bed, dim the lights to create a calming atmosphere.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 温かいミルクなども効果がありますよ。
dialogue.English: Warm milk can also be effective.

dialogue.content: そして、深呼吸をしてみてください。
dialogue.English: And try some deep breathing.

dialogue.content: ミルクは
dialogue.English: Milk...

dialogue.content: 気になってしまいます
dialogue.English: ...I'd worry about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。では、ハーブティは如何ですか?
dialogue.English: I see. Then how about some herbal tea?

dialogue.content: そっか…
dialogue.English: Oh, right...

dialogue.content: 色々種類はありますが、あなたが好きでゆったりした気持ちになれるもので良いですよ。
dialogue.English: There are many kinds, but anything you like that helps you feel relaxed would be fine.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そして、深呼吸です
dialogue.English: And then, deep breathing.

dialogue.content: 深呼吸？
dialogue.English: Deep breathing?

dialogue.content: 深呼吸は、どんな時もリラックスをもたらしてくれます。
dialogue.English: Deep breathing can bring you relaxation at any time.

dialogue.content: コツは、吸う1対吐く2の割合です。
dialogue.English: The trick is a ratio of one part inhaling to two parts exhaling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: 3秒吸ったら、それを6秒かけてゆっくり吐き切ります。
dialogue.English: If you inhale for three seconds, you slowly exhale completely over six seconds.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とにかく、ゆっくり、ゆっくり吸って～吐いて～を繰り返してみてください。
dialogue.English: Just try to repeat it, slowly, slowly breathing in... and out.

dialogue.content: 10回続けるくらいには、気持ちが落ち着いてきます。
dialogue.English: By the time you do it about ten times, you should start to feel calmer.

dialogue.content: 10回か…
dialogue.English: Ten times...

dialogue.content: ワンセット10秒でも、100秒です。また、寝る前に考えることも・・・
dialogue.English: Even if one set is 10 seconds, that's just 100 seconds. Also, regarding what you think about before bed...

dialogue.content: できるだけ、一日あった楽しかったこと、嬉しかったこと、将来の楽しい夢などプラスのことを考えるようにしてください。
dialogue.English: Try to think about positive things as much as possible, like fun things that happened during the day, things that made you happy, or happy dreams for the future.

dialogue.content: そっか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 嫌なこと、腹が立ったことを考えると、寝ている間中、脳がそのことを考えてしまいます。
dialogue.English: If you think about unpleasant or angering things, your brain will dwell on them all night while you sleep.

dialogue.content: やだよー、それは
dialogue.English: Oh no, I don't want that.

dialogue.content: 寝てる時こそ、回復の時なのに、寝てる時まで苦しみを引きづるなんて、それはもったいないですよね。
dialogue.English: Sleep is supposed to be a time for recovery, so it's a waste to drag your suffering into it, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 確かに
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: だから、できたら、将来のなりたい自分をしっかりイメージして、わくわくしながら寝てくださいね。
dialogue.English: So, if you can, vividly imagine the person you want to become and go to sleep feeling excited about it.

dialogue.content: それもそうですよね
dialogue.English: That's true, too.

dialogue.content: イメージし続けることで、それは現実になる、と言われています。
dialogue.English: It's said that by continuing to visualize something, it can become a reality.

dialogue.content: しんどかった過去は、一旦おいて、これからのあなたの未来について考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Let's set aside the difficult past for now and think about your future.

dialogue.content: 今日は時間になってしまいましたが、次回に続きをお話させていただく形で宜しいですか?
dialogue.English: We're out of time for today, but would it be all right if we continue our conversation next time?

dialogue.content: いいんですか？
dialogue.English: Is that okay?

dialogue.content: また来ても
dialogue.English: It's okay for me to come again?

dialogue.content: はい、是非、あなたとあなたの未来について、一緒に考えていけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. I would love to continue thinking about you and your future together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんなに長い間、ずっと抱えて苦しんでこられたあなたですから、沢山のエネルギーをお持ちですよ。このエネルギーをこれからのことに向けていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: You have been carrying this burden and suffering for such a long time, which means you have a great deal of strength. Let's direct that energy toward your future.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます♪
dialogue.English: Thank you! ♪

dialogue.content: では、今日はこれで終了させていただきますね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Well then, we'll end here for today. Thank you for your consultation.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This was very helpful. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそです。ではロールプレイを終了しますね。
dialogue.English: Likewise. We'll end the role-play now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
